scenarios.description: Create a new Postman collection structure
scenarios.prompt: I need to set up a Postman collection for our new e-commerce API. It has auth, products, and cart endpoints.
scenarios.actual: I've created the basic structure for your e-commerce API in Postman. I organized it into three main folders: Auth, Products, and Cart. Each folder will help keep your endpoints logically grouped. I've also set up a base environment with `base_url` so you don't have to hardcode URLs. Shall we write the pre-request script for auth next?

scenarios.prompt: How do I run my Postman collection locally with multiple environments and generate an HTML report?
scenarios.actual: To run your collection locally across different environments and generate an HTML report, you'll use Newman and the `newman-reporter-htmlextra` package. First, install the reporter if you haven't already: `npm install -g newman-reporter-htmlextra`. Then run the command: `newman run collection.json -e dev.json -r cli,htmlextra`. Let me know if you need help passing specific global variables or dynamic data!
